comment: Schwinger monopole-antimonopole pair production in Run 3 PbPb. Adding "temperature": T to kinematics.p overrides the automatic calculation of the variable based on sqrtsNN. The field kicks the monopole by +g*k and the antimonopole by -g*k, transverse to the beam in a direction drawn per event, with k = g_0 B / omega per Dirac charge calculated from sqrtsNN; a top-level "fieldKick" (GeV per Dirac charge, 0 = off) overrides the calculation. Matching transport keys: G4.monopole=1;G4.monopoleMass=100;G4.monopoleMagneticCharge=1
